## Three cycles, and how long each took

## Why the headline numbers moved

The record carries three. Peak 1151 to trough 152, down 86.8 percent, 37 months to recover.

## The decisive metrics, read

Peak 19783 to trough 3122, down 84.2 percent, 35 months. Peak 68789 to trough 15476, down 77.5 percent, 25 months.

## What would change my mind

Two readings follow. Drawdowns have been getting shallower and recoveries shorter. And every one of those recoveries took longer than a year - so a twelve-month horizon priced off a cycle repeat is priced off the fastest of three observations, not the average of them.

scenarios.name: Custody unwind
scenarios.rationale: INVENTED FIXTURE - fund creations reverse and price seeks the market's average purchase price of 53049, then overshoots below it as forced miner supply lands.

scenarios.name: Range holds
scenarios.rationale: INVENTED FIXTURE - flows stay positive but unremarkable and price grinds back toward the recent-buyer average of 69980.

scenarios.name: Cycle repeats
scenarios.rationale: INVENTED FIXTURE - the pattern of the three recorded cycles repeats from a market sitting near its long-run average on the measure of where it stands in its own cycle.
